python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# NASA outlays from FY 2008-2017 (in millions of dollars)
# From 2012 bulletin (page 24) - FY 2008-2012
# From 2017 bulletin (page 22) - FY 2013-2017
nasa_outlays = [
    17834,  # FY 2008
    19168,  # FY 2009
    18906,  # FY 2010
    17617,  # FY 2011
    17190,  # FY 2012
    16978,  # FY 2013
    17093,  # FY 2014
    18272,  # FY 2015
    18828,  # FY 2016
    18698,  # FY 2017
]

print("NASA Outlays (millions):")
for i, val in enumerate(nasa_outlays, 2008):
    print(f"  FY {i}: {val}")

# Convert to billions
nasa_billions = [v / 1000 for v in nasa_outlays]
print("\nNASA Outlays (billions):")
for i, val in enumerate(nasa_billions, 2008):
    print(f"  FY {i}: {val}")

print(f"\nOriginal data (billions): {nasa_billions}")
print(f"Min: {min(nasa_billions)}")
print(f"Max: {max(nasa_billions)}")

# 10% Winsorized mean/range
# For 10 values, 10% winsorization means:
# - Replace the lowest 10% (1 value) with the 10th percentile
# - Replace the highest 10% (1 value) with the 90th percentile

n = len(nasa_billions)
print(f"\nn = {n}")

# Sort to find percentiles
sorted_data = sorted(nasa_billions)
print(f"Sorted: {sorted_data}")

# 10th percentile position (Type 7 / pandas default)
p10_pos = (n - 1) * 0.10 + 1
print(f"10th percentile position: {p10_pos}")

# 90th percentile position
p90_pos = (n - 1) * 0.90 + 1
print(f"90th percentile position: {p90_pos}")

# Interpolate for p10
idx_p10 = int(p10_pos) - 1
frac_p10 = p10_pos - int(p10_pos)
p10_value = sorted_data[idx_p10] + frac_p10 * (sorted_data[idx_p10 + 1] - sorted_data[idx_p10])
print(f"10th percentile value: {p10_value}")

# Interpolate for p90
idx_p90 = int(p90_pos) - 1
frac_p90 = p90_pos - int(p90_pos)
p90_value = sorted_data[idx_p90] + frac_p90 * (sorted_data[idx_p90 + 1] - sorted_data[idx_p90])
print(f"90th percentile value: {p90_value}")

# Winsorize
winsorized = []
for val in nasa_billions:
    if val < p10_value:
        winsorized.append(p10_value)
    elif val > p90_value:
        winsorized.append(p90_value)
    else:
        winsorized.append(val)

print(f"\nWinsorized data: {winsorized}")

# 10% Winsorized range = max - min of winsorized data
winsorized_min = min(winsorized)
winsorized_max = max(winsorized)
winsorized_range = winsorized_max - winsorized_min

print(f"\nWinsorized min: {winsorized_min}")
print(f"Winsorized max: {winsorized_max}")
print(f"10% Winsorized range: {winsorized_range}")

# Round to hundredths
result = round(winsorized_range, 2)
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded to hundredths): {result}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# NASA outlays from FY 2008-2017 (in millions of dollars)
nasa_outlays = [17834, 19168, 18906, 17617, 17190, 16978, 17093, 18272, 18828, 18698]

# Convert to billions
nasa_billions = [v / 1000 for v in nasa_outlays]
print(f"NASA outlays in billions: {nasa_billions}")

sorted_data = sorted(nasa_billions)
print(f"Sorted: {sorted_data}")

n = len(sorted_data)
print(f"n = {n}")

# Type 7 (pandas default) percentile calculation
# h = (n-1)*p + 1

# 10th percentile
h_10 = (n - 1) * 0.10 + 1  # = 1.9
print(f"\n10th percentile: h = {h_10}")
lower_idx = int(h_10) - 1  # 0 (index of 1.9's integer part minus 1)
frac = h_10 - int(h_10)  # 0.9
print(f"  Lower index: {lower_idx}, Fraction: {frac}")
p10 = sorted_data[lower_idx] + frac * (sorted_data[lower_idx + 1] - sorted_data[lower_idx])
print(f"  10th percentile = {sorted_data[lower_idx]} + {frac} * ({sorted_data[lower_idx + 1]} - {sorted_data[lower_idx]}) = {p10}")

# 90th percentile
h_90 = (n - 1) * 0.90 + 1  # = 9.1
print(f"\n90th percentile: h = {h_90}")
lower_idx_90 = int(h_90) - 1  # 8
frac_90 = h_90 - int(h_90)  # 0.1
print(f"  Lower index: {lower_idx_90}, Fraction: {frac_90}")
p90 = sorted_data[lower_idx_90] + frac_90 * (sorted_data[lower_idx_90 + 1] - sorted_data[lower_idx_90])
print(f"  90th percentile = {sorted_data[lower_idx_90]} + {frac_90} * ({sorted_data[lower_idx_90 + 1]} - {sorted_data[lower_idx_90]}) = {p90}")

# Winsorize
winsorized = []
for val in nasa_billions:
    if val <= p10:  # Replace values at or below 10th percentile
        winsorized.append(p10)
    elif val >= p90:  # Replace values at or above 90th percentile
        winsorized.append(p90)
    else:
        winsorized.append(val)

print(f"\nWinsorized values: {winsorized}")
print(f"Original vs Winsorized:")
for i, (orig, wins) in enumerate(zip(nasa_billions, winsorized)):
    marker = " <-- winsorized" if orig != wins else ""
    print(f"  FY {2008+i}: {orig:.3f} -> {wins:.4f}{marker}")

winsorized_min = min(winsorized)
winsorized_max = max(winsorized)
winsorized_range = winsorized_max - winsorized_min

print(f"\nWinsorized min: {winsorized_min}")
print(f"Winsorized max: {winsorized_max}")
print(f"10% Winsorized range = {winsorized_max} - {winsorized_min} = {winsorized_range}")

# Round to hundredths
result = round(winsorized_range, 2)
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded to hundredths): {result}")
EOF
